name: University / Higher Education Institution
description: Organization structure for a university, college, or higher education institution. Covers shared governance with faculty senate, academic affairs through deans and department chairs, research administration, and operational divisions. Tenure-track faculty, lecturers, adjuncts, graduate teaching assistants, and professional staff. Includes student affairs, athletics, development/alumni relations, admissions, registrar, and accreditation compliance. Designed for mid-to-large institutions serving 5,000-50,000 students.

org_structure.overview: Universities operate under a dual structure of academic affairs and administration, led by a President/Chancellor with a Provost overseeing all academic functions and a VP of Administration handling operations. Academic departments enjoy significant autonomy in curriculum and hiring, while faculty governance bodies (Faculty Senate, department committees) share decision-making on academic policy, tenure, and promotion. Institutional accreditation (regional or national) is a binding framework that shapes processes across all units. Budget authority typically flows from the Board of Trustees through the President, with deans controlling school-level budgets and department chairs managing operational allocations. Research universities add a layer of sponsored programs administration, IRB/IACUC compliance, and technology transfer.

departments.name: Board of Trustees / Regents
departments.description: Governing board responsible for institutional mission, strategic direction, fiscal oversight, and presidential selection/evaluation. Fiduciary authority over endowment and major capital decisions.

roles.title: Board Chair
roles.description: Leads board meetings, works with President on strategy, chairs executive committee.

roles.title: Trustee / Regent
roles.description: Votes on major institutional decisions; serves on board committees (finance, academic, audit, advancement).

departments.name: Office of the President / Chancellor
departments.description: Chief executive office providing institutional vision, external representation, fundraising leadership, and executive oversight. Manages cabinet-level relationships with the board, faculty senate, and external partners.

roles.title: President / Chancellor
roles.description: Chief executive officer. Sets institutional vision, leads fundraising, represents the university externally.

roles.title: Chief of Staff
roles.description: Manages the President's office, cabinet coordination, and strategic project execution.

roles.title: Executive Assistant to the President
roles.description: Manages scheduling, correspondence, and board meeting logistics.

roles.title: General Counsel
roles.description: Provides legal counsel on compliance, risk, employment, student affairs, and intellectual property.

departments.name: Academic Affairs (Provost)
departments.description: The central academic administration led by the Provost, overseeing all schools/colleges, faculty hiring and tenure, curriculum, research, libraries, and academic policy. Partners with Faculty Senate on shared governance.

roles.title: Provost / Vice President for Academic Affairs
roles.description: Chief academic officer. Oversees all academic programs, faculty, research, and accreditation.

roles.title: Vice Provost for Faculty Affairs
roles.description: Manages tenure and promotion processes, faculty development, and diversity initiatives.

roles.title: Vice Provost for Research
roles.description: Oversees sponsored research, compliance (IRB, IACUC), tech transfer, and research development.

roles.title: Vice Provost for Undergraduate Education
roles.description: Leads general education, advising, first-year experience, and undergraduate research programs.

roles.title: Dean of Graduate Studies
roles.description: Oversees graduate program quality, graduate student funding, and thesis/dissertation policies.

roles.title: Dean of Libraries
roles.description: Leads university library system, special collections, scholarly communication, and research support.

roles.title: Director of Institutional Research / Accreditation
roles.description: Manages data reporting, accreditation self-studies, program review, and compliance.

roles.title: Director of International Programs
roles.description: Oversees study abroad, international partnerships, and visa support for international scholars.

departments.name: Colleges / Schools
departments.description: Academic units organized by discipline (e.g., College of Arts & Sciences, School of Engineering, Business School). Each led by a Dean who manages curriculum, faculty, budget, and strategic direction for the school.

roles.title: Dean
roles.description: Academic and administrative head of a college/school. Manages budget, faculty hiring, curriculum, and fundraising.

roles.title: Associate Dean for Academic Affairs
roles.description: Oversees curriculum, scheduling, student academic affairs, and accreditation within the school.

roles.title: Associate Dean for Research
roles.description: Supports faculty research development, grant administration, and lab facilities.

roles.title: Department Chair
roles.description: Leads an academic department; manages faculty, course scheduling, and departmental budget.

roles.title: Professor (Tenured)
roles.description: Senior faculty with indefinite appointment. Teaches, conducts research, advises students, serves on committees.

roles.title: Associate Professor (Tenure-Track)
roles.description: Mid-career faculty on tenure track. Expected to demonstrate research productivity, teaching excellence, and service.

roles.title: Assistant Professor (Tenure-Track)
roles.description: Early-career faculty on tenure track. Focused on establishing research program and developing teaching portfolio.

roles.title: Lecturer / Instructor (Non-Tenure Track)
roles.description: Teaching-focused faculty on term contracts. May be full or part-time. Not on tenure track.

roles.title: Adjunct Faculty
roles.description: Part-time faculty hired per course. Typically practitioners or scholars at other institutions.

roles.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant (TA)
roles.description: Graduate student who assists with teaching, grading, lab sections, or recitations.

roles.title: Graduate Research Assistant (RA)
roles.description: Graduate student funded on a research grant who conducts research under faculty supervision.

departments.name: Administration & Finance
departments.description: Manages institutional budget, human resources, facilities, IT, and ancillary services. Ensures operational stability and regulatory compliance.

roles.title: VP for Administration & Finance / CFO
roles.description: Chief financial and administrative officer. Oversees budget, finance, HR, facilities, and IT.

roles.title: Controller / Director of Finance
roles.description: Manages accounting, financial reporting, audit, and internal controls.

roles.title: Director of Human Resources
roles.description: Leads recruitment, benefits, employee relations, training, and compliance.

roles.title: Director of Facilities & Operations
roles.description: Manages campus buildings, grounds, custodial services, and capital projects.

roles.title: CIO / Director of Information Technology
roles.description: Leads IT infrastructure, campus network, enterprise systems, and cybersecurity.

roles.title: Director of Auxiliary Services
roles.description: Oversees housing/dining, bookstores, parking, and conference services.

roles.title: Director of Public Safety / Campus Police
roles.description: Manages campus security, emergency response, and Clery Act compliance.

departments.name: Enrollment Management & Student Affairs
departments.description: Manages the full student lifecycle from recruitment and admissions through registration and graduation. Includes academic advising, career services, housing, student activities, and wellness.

roles.title: VP for Enrollment Management / Student Affairs
roles.description: Leads admissions, financial aid, registrar, student life, and student support services.

roles.title: Director of Admissions
roles.description: Manages recruitment, application processing, and admissions decisions.

roles.title: Admissions Counselor
roles.description: Recruits prospective students, conducts campus tours, reviews applications.

roles.title: Director of Financial Aid
roles.description: Manages scholarship, grant, and loan programs; ensures compliance with federal aid regulations.

roles.title: Registrar
roles.description: Manages course registration, transcripts, degree audits, diplomas, and academic records.

roles.title: Dean of Students
roles.description: Oversees student conduct, crisis response, student organizations, and advocacy.

roles.title: Director of Career Services
roles.description: Provides career counseling, internship placement, employer relations, and job search support.

roles.title: Director of Housing & Residence Life
roles.description: Manages on-campus housing, resident advisors, and residential programming.

roles.title: Director of Counseling & Wellness
roles.description: Provides mental health counseling, health services, and wellness programming.

departments.name: Research & Sponsored Programs
departments.description: Supports the research enterprise including grant administration, compliance, technology transfer, and research development. Manages relationships with funding agencies and industry partners.

roles.title: Director of Sponsored Programs
roles.description: Manages pre- and post-award grant administration, compliance, and reporting.

roles.title: Grants & Contracts Administrator
roles.description: Processes grant proposals, manages award setup, financial reporting, and closeout.

roles.title: Director of Research Compliance
roles.description: Oversees IRB, IACUC, export control, and research misconduct proceedings.

roles.title: Director of Technology Transfer
roles.description: Manages patent filings, licensing, and commercialization of university inventions.

roles.title: Research Development Officer
roles.description: Identifies funding opportunities, supports large grant proposals, and facilitates interdisciplinary teams.

departments.name: University Advancement / Development
departments.description: Manages fundraising, alumni relations, and donor stewardship. Drives the campaign cycle including major gifts, annual giving, planned giving, and corporate/foundation relations.

roles.title: VP for University Advancement
roles.description: Leads all fundraising, alumni engagement, and donor relations strategy.

roles.title: Director of Development / Major Gifts
roles.description: Manages major gift officers and principal gift strategy.

roles.title: Major Gift Officer
roles.description: Cultivates and solicits major gift prospects ($25K+). Manages donor portfolios.

roles.title: Director of Annual Giving
roles.description: Manages annual fund campaigns, direct mail, digital fundraising, and phonathon.

roles.title: Director of Alumni Relations
roles.description: Engages alumni through events, chapters, volunteer programs, and communications.

roles.title: Director of Corporate & Foundation Relations
roles.description: Builds partnerships with corporations and foundations for philanthropic support.

roles.title: Advancement Communications Specialist
roles.description: Writes proposals, stewardship reports, and alumni magazine content.

departments.name: Athletics
departments.description: Manages intercollegiate athletic programs including coaching, compliance (NCAA/NAIA), sports medicine, facilities, and athletic scholarships. Significant variation based on divisional level (D1-D3).

roles.title: Athletic Director
roles.description: Leads the athletics department; manages coaches, budget, compliance, and facilities.

roles.title: Head Coach (per sport)
roles.description: Leads a specific sport program; responsible for coaching, recruiting, and player development.

roles.title: Assistant Coach
roles.description: Assists with coaching, recruiting, training, and game preparation for a specific sport.

roles.title: Athletic Trainer
roles.description: Provides injury prevention, assessment, treatment, and rehabilitation for student-athletes.

roles.title: Director of Sports Information
roles.description: Manages media relations, statistics, game coverage, and athletic communications.

roles.title: Compliance Officer
roles.description: Ensures NCAA/NAIA compliance, eligibility, and rules education for staff and athletes.

roles.title: Strength & Conditioning Coach
roles.description: Designs and supervises athletic performance training programs.

key_relationships: Board of Trustees appoints and evaluates the President; the President reports to the Board and implements strategic direction.
Provost reports to the President and holds authority over all Deans; Deans manage Department Chairs who supervise faculty.
Faculty Senate is the primary shared governance body; the Provost and President consult the Senate on academic policy, curriculum changes, and tenure criteria.
VP for Administration & Finance partners with the Provost on budget allocation across academic and administrative units.
VP for Enrollment Management works closely with Deans on enrollment targets, admissions criteria, and retention strategies.
Graduate TAs and RAs are supervised by faculty but may receive funding through the Graduate School; the Dean of Graduate Studies sets policy.
Research & Sponsored Programs supports faculty in grant administration; the Vice Provost for Research advocates for research infrastructure.
University Advancement works with Deans and the President to align fundraising priorities with institutional needs.
Athletics reports to the President and coordinates with Admissions on athlete recruitment and with Student Affairs on athlete welfare.
Accreditation bodies (regional, programmatic) require institution-wide compliance; Institutional Research coordinates evidence collection across all units.
